metadata.name: treasury
metadata.description: Opening Cross treasury template: a program-custodied treasury with a periodic spend allowance, attestation-gated release, and holder-triggered pro-rata liquidation when attestations lapse.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Receives a spend; ignored by the NAV kinds (pass any quote account).

instructions.name: init_ext
docs: Grows a treasury by the extension tail and creates its coin and distribution vaults. Once.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: `sas_attestation::is_valid` against the nonce derived from the treasury and the round.

instructions.name: record_attested
docs: Anyone records that a live attestation is back, clearing a recorded lapse.

instructions.name: record_lapse
docs: Anyone records that the attestation is missing or expired. Starts the grace clock once.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: A holder burns `amount` coins for `snapshot_vault · amount / snapshot_supply` quote atoms.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: checked by `sas_attestation::is_valid`. Pass any account for a carve-out.

instructions.name: spend
docs: The team spends within the period's allowance, only while the attestation is live.

instructions.name: trigger_liquidation
docs: After a lapse longer than the grace period, anyone moves the treasury into liquidation.

types.name: ExtParams
docs: What the team chooses when it extends a treasury. Every field is fixed afterwards.

fields.name: bps
docs: Share of the grant this milestone releases, in basis points.

fields.name: requires_attestation
docs: False: a carve-out, released when the lockup ends. True: an earn-out, released only against
a live attestation at `milestone_nonce(grant, index)` under the grant's credential and schema.

fields.name: debt
docs: `floor(amount * acc / PREC)` as of the last change; pending reward is the growth since.

fields.name: pending
docs: Reward settled but not yet claimed.

fields.name: allowance
docs: Quote atoms the team may spend per period.

fields.name: grace_secs
docs: How long a recorded lapse must last before liquidation may be triggered.

fields.name: credential
docs: SAS credential and schema whose attestation (nonce = this treasury) keeps it active.
